meta.note: One places dataset for every map on the Kohlmann site; the engine Family Map reads it. Every place here is drawn. Living people are on the map like anyone else, at the family's wish (Sebastian Belfiore, 26 November 2026). Leads are drawn as "no proven link". Business associates of the family firm are drawn as "Business associate. Not family". Places that could not be placed are listed on the map page tray and in the project notes, not here. places.name: Kötzschau near Lawalde
places.blurb: Lead only. Ernst Alwin Kohlmann, the Bautzen butcher, was born here on 21 September 1883. Kötzschau is a hamlet of Kleindehsa in the parish of Lawalde, near Löbau; his birth was registered at Lawalde. He is one of the leads being checked for Herbert Kohlmann's family; nothing links him to the family. Ernestine Hedwig Kohlmann, probably his sister, was born in Kleindehsa, the same village, in 1897. In 1787 the village judge here was a Johann Kohlmann, whose son Gottfried bought the inn at Kleindehsa; no record yet links him to the Bautzen Kohlmanns. A court file of 1807 to 1809 concerns the villagers of Kötzschau against a Christian Kohlmann, who had refused part of his labour service for the manor.

places.name: Kleindehsa
places.blurb: Lead only. A village near Löbau, now part of Lawalde. Its village inn, the Kretscham, belonged to a Kohlmann family from 1787 until 1959, according to the village chronicle. Ernestine Hedwig Kohlmann, probably the sister of Alwin Kohlmann the Bautzen butcher, was born here in 1897. Newspapers show the innkeepers at work: J. T. Kohlmann, butcher and innkeeper, in 1856; Karl Friedrich Ernst Kohlmann, owner of the Kretscham, in 1874; the court sale of 1889 from his widow's estate; the master butcher and cattle dealer Reinhold Kohlmann in 1913; and "Kohlmanns Gasthof" on the bus timetable in 1926. No record yet links these innkeepers to the family. The Kretscham burned down on 29 January 1997 and was pulled down.
